test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Unless you complete your school education, you cannot get yourself ________ into a college.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2, "enrolled"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enroll **means to become or to make somebody a member of a club, school, etc. (संस्‍था आदि का सदस्‍य बनना या बनाना, स्‍कूल आदि में भरती होना या करना)

 
 
• **For example-** *They enrolled 100 new students last year.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about completing school education to get admission to college, so the appropriate word here is "**enrolled**".
 
• In the sentence, the word "**enrolled**" should be used as a verb.
 
• So, "Enrolled" fits perfectly here because it accurately conveys the idea of becoming a student in a formal educational institution.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *Unless you complete your school education, you cannot get yourself enrolled __into a college. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Advanced**", means to move forward or make progress, but it does not fit in the given sentence. (आगे बढ़ना या उन्नति करना)
 
• Option 3: "**Mopped**", is a verb that means cleaning with a mop. (पोछे से सफ़ाई करना)
 
• Option 4: "**Accommodated**", means providing lodging or space for someone. (किसी के लिए आवास या स्थान उपलब्ध कराना)

19f:T632,
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **"formed, they eventually becomes."**
